emotional_archetype: Architectural Command & Precision (High Density, Calm, Authoritative)

design_philosophy.principle_1: Domain Color Spectrum - Every architectural domain (Business, Application, Data, Security, Integration, Technology) carries its immutable color and icon identity across badges, nodes, charts, tables, and impact graphs.
design_philosophy.principle_2: End-to-End Visual Traceability - Deep interconnectivity made tangible through reactive node graphs, breadcrumbs, and 360° detail views.
design_philosophy.principle_3: High-Density Calm - Structured Swiss-inspired grid layout with strict 1px border lines, subtle background fills, generous cell padding, and zero unnecessary decorative noise.
design_philosophy.principle_4: Proactive Governance - Workflows for Architecture Reviews, ADRs, Technical Debt, and Standards clearly surfaced via state-aware status pills and audit markers.

traceability_impact_graph.node_colors: Strictly inherits domain colors (e.g., Business=Amber, App=Blue, Data=Emerald, Security=Red, Integration=Violet, Tech=Slate)

review_workflow.ui_style: Horizontal stepped progress bar + approval action bar + comments timeline

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_policy: All interactive elements, buttons, menu items, table rows, domain cards, graph nodes, and search inputs MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='brand-logo', data-testid='domain-card-business', data-testid='global-search-input').
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_standard: Minimum WCAG AA (4.5:1 ratio) on all body text and badges.
testing_and_accessibility.hover_rule: Always explicitly define hover text colors matching or exceeding active state contrast.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure brand name 'Colecle' and logo are reactive to Admin Brand Settings stored in state/localStorage or backend API.
Strictly enforce domain colors in all lists, tags, chips, charts, and graph nodes.
Add data-testid attributes to all key components for reliable test suite automation.
Use JavaScript / JSX files (.js / .jsx) as defined in workspace rules.
Ensure dark mode is default or easily toggled with rich high-contrast colors.
